bullets.text: Residents in Thiruvallur district protested on the road at midnight due to a three-hour power cut, and the office should monitor local grid stability.
A cyclonic storm is likely to form over the Bay of Bengal by November 1 and bring moderate rain, so the district team must watch for weather warnings.
Damaged and missing concrete slabs on the Manavalanagar ROB in Thiruvallur put the public at risk, and the office should urge the State Highways department to fix them.
Cisco executive Jeetu Patel supports giving Gen Z unlimited AI tools to accelerate software development, which the portfolio team should note for future workforce strategies.
OpenAI chief Sam Altman questioned heavy PC RAM usage amid global DRAM supply pressure, and the office should watch how hardware constraints impact AI deployment.
